items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: I took Cornish's place... So I went to their rehearsal one night... Ed Barrett, the bass player, and Will Wilson and Johnny Wilson, we walked.

ctx.x: I took Cornish's place. You see they had been using different trombones, I don't know, they were scouting around. So I went to their rehearsal one night. True, I knew all of them and they all knew me. And I sat down and rehearsed with them. So coming home, Ed Barrett, the bass player, and Will Wilson and Johnny Wilson, we walked.
